title: HDFC with OTPs and bills is tier 2, via one cached model call per business

setup.note: wa:hdfcbank is a business sender (is_business) the user never wrote to: OTPs, debits, statements, EMIs. Code cannot split tier 2/3/4 here, so ONE tier.v1 call runs; the verdict is cached on the stream by the channel's character, and a second tiering pass makes no call.

Alert: Rs.2,499.00 spent on HDFC Bank Card **4321 at AMAZON PAY on 12-Aug-26. Not you? Call 18002586161.
Your OTP is 118273 for a transaction of Rs.1,200.00 at SWIGGY. Valid for 5 mins.
HDFC Bank: EMI of Rs.8,400.00 for loan a/c **7781 is due on 15-Aug-26. Please maintain sufficient balance.
Dear Customer, your HDFC Bank FD of Rs.2,00,000 matures on 30-Sep-26. Renewal instructions: auto-renew.

input_events: 8 messages from HDFC Bank on wa:hdfcbank over 20 days: OTPs, debits, a statement, an EMI, an FD maturity — none from self

expected.tier: 2 — the user transacts with this business and it sends updates (OTPs, bills); reason names the active account/bills; confidence high

wrong.label: business-tier1
wrong.assert_absent: a business the user never wrote to at tier 1

wrong.label: reask-per-message
wrong.assert_absent: more than one tier.v1 call for one business in one pass

wrong.label: cache-miss
wrong.assert_absent: a second tier.v1 call for a channel whose character did not change
